proposed_widenings.name: scrying_sensor
proposed_widenings.justification: Scrying creates an invisible, intangible sensor near the target through which the caster can see and hear. This is fundamentally distinct from the 'detect' atom (radial presence-scanning) — it is a persistent remote-viewing link that follows the subject creature for the concentration duration. No existing v4 atom covers creating and perceiving through a projected mobile sensor.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, the spell creates an Invisible, intangible sensor within 10 feet of the target. You can see and hear through the sensor as if you were there. The sensor moves with the target, remaining within 10 feet of it for the duration.

proposed_widenings.name: DcSource: save_dc_with_cast_time_modifier
proposed_widenings.justification: Scrying's Wisdom save DC is the caster's spell save DC adjusted by two independent cast-time choices from tables (familiarity: +5/+0/-5; connection: -2/-4/-10). Current DcSource variants (caster_spell_save_dc, fixed, weapon_attack_dc, innate_dc) have no mechanism for a base DC plus additive cast-time-chosen modifiers. A new variant such as { kind: 'caster_spell_save_dc_with_modifier', modifier: number } or a cast-time choice of modifiers is required.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw, which is modified (see the tables below) by how well you know the target and the sort of physical connection you have to it.

proposed_widenings.name: Attachment: location (general, not AnchorTarget)
proposed_widenings.justification: Scrying can alternatively target a visible location instead of a creature. The Attachment union has no 'location' kind for activation/ongoing contexts ('location' exists only on AnchorTarget for the anchored_trigger family). A general-purpose 'location' Attachment variant is needed for divination spells that plant sensors at known places.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Instead of targeting a creature, you can target a location you have seen. When you do so, the sensor appears at that location and doesn't move.

proposed_widenings.name: SaveSuccessOutcome: timed_reuse_ban
proposed_widenings.justification: On a successful save the caster is barred from casting Scrying on the same target for 24 hours. No existing save success outcome covers a time-gated reuse restriction. This is distinct from 'none' (which just means no effect) — the restriction is a secondary consequence of a successful defense.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a successful save, the target isn't affected, and you can't use this spell on it again for 24 hours.

notes: Scrying is not authored as dhall because its core on-fail effect — creating a remote perception sensor that follows the target — has no honest encoding. The 'detect' atom covers presence-scanning; Scrying is a persistent, mobile, two-way sensory link. The variable DC (spell save DC + cast-time table modifiers) is also not expressible in DcSource. Three additional widenings (variable DC, location attachment, timed reuse ban on success) are secondary but also genuine gaps. All four are surface-widening or atom-widening in scope; none requires a new top-level payload family.
